title: Community LLM Conductor: deterministic weight normalization, variant equivalence tests, and profile publish pipeline
creator: Marco Ruiz
description: Build an end-to-end pipeline component (Conductor) that normalizes community model weight bundles, performs deterministic conversion to Redwood runtime artifacts, verifies variant equivalence across quantization/format variants, and publishes a signed performance profile into the model catalog. The conductor should integrate with the existing Artifact Gateway, run the deterministic smoke suite, generate canonical pins and signed manifests, and emit telemetry for coverage and regressions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) For a provided OSS weights tarball, Conductor produces a deterministic runtime artifact (same inputs -> bit-identical outputs across runs) and a canonical pin manifest
2) Variant equivalence tests pass: baseline FP16 reference and target quantized/optimized variants produce token-level convergence within defined thresholds on smoke prompts
3) The published profile includes latency, memory, token-cost estimates, and a signature verifiable by the catalog service
4) End-to-end pipeline hooks exist: ingest -> conversion -> variant tests -> profile publish -> catalog index update
5) Telemetry emitted for per-stage durations, failure class, and sampling of token-level diffs
6) Security review completed and KMS signing integrated for customer-sensitive pins
decisions: Use deterministic conversion tooling (containerized, pinned toolchain) to guarantee reproducible artifacts rather than relying on opportunistic conversions
Adopt a two-step verification: binary equivalence for same-format conversions + statistical equivalence for quantized/optimized variants
Publish signed manifests using Redwood KMS-backed keys and rotate keys via ops cadence; consider optional sigstore integration later
Variant equivalence tolerance: BLEU-like and token-level perplexity delta thresholds defined in docs link below
implementation_notes: Wrap conversion in hermetic container (bazel build + snapshot of pip deps) to ensure deterministic outputs
Leverage existing Artifact Gateway job spec schema but extend metadata with 'conversion_tool_version' and 'conversion_digest' fields
Re-use the runtime's profiling harness for latency/throughput measurements; add a short, deterministic input set (10 prompts) for smoke tests
Create a modular verification runner so new quantization strategies can be added without changing conductor flow

telemetry_requirements: Emit start/end timestamps for: ingest, unpack, conversion, variant-tests, profile-publish
Sample token-level diffs for 1% of runs and store diffs to S3 for regression investigations
Tag failures with failure_class and include original artifact reference for replay
risk_assessment: High operational risk if conversion is non-deterministic — could break pin uniqueness and rollback logic
Medium risk around license/TOU detection mistakes; include human-in-the-loop gating for ambiguous licenses
Low risk on telemetry storage once sampling limits are enforced

Functional smoke: 10 fixed prompts for latency and token-output sanity
Variant equivalence: measured token-logprob delta and top-k output overlap must be within thresholds
Integration: end-to-end ingest -> publish dry run into staging catalog
